Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: CREATING
Topic 4.1: Creating

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Creating. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS
